messages:
incident-bot: [P0] Detected spike in 5xxs for /v1/generate on hosted inference (us-west-2). Paging oncall.

tim (oncall): ack — paged and on my way. I'll start triage.

tim (oncall): quick snapshot: queue length + autoscaler failing to provision new nodes (quota error). logs: `ASG: scale_out failed: InsufficientInstanceCapacity`.

raj (eng): pulling controller logs. seeing repeated `RateLimitExceeded` from cloud provider when requesting new GPUs. Also some embed-service timeouts spiking.

sara (support): Stratus Claims (enterprise) just flagged 500s in prod webhooks. We need tailored comms and contact routing. Immediate customer-facing note required.

lucy (cs): Stratus contacts: Janelle Park (AM) jpark@stratus.com, Marco Ruiz (SE) mruiz@stratus.com. They want ETA + mitigation steps. Please include who to call.

tim (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) attempt manual node add with lower instance type 2) if that fails, failover Stratus traffic to us-east-1 per fallback routing policy. I'll try (1) now.

status-bot: DRAFT status page blurb: "We are investigating increased error rates for inference requests in US-West-2 which may result in 500 responses or increased latencies for some customers. We are actively mitigating; updates every 15 minutes." Suggest adding: affected customers list for tailored outreach.

sara (support): add sentence: "Affected customers may experience intermittent failures for synchronous generation and streaming timeouts for long-running sessions." Approve to publish and send tailored email to Stratus.

tim (oncall): manual add attempt started. If cloud quota prevents expansion, I'll flip routing for Stratus within 20m.

raj (eng): prepping a fallback model variant (lighter quantized) that reduces GPU memory and should succeed on smaller instance types. Need greenlight to promote as temporary fallback.

tim (oncall): greenlighted. Proceed with canary fallback for Stratus routes only.

sara (support): Drafting tailored email to Stratus now. Snippet:

"Hi Janelle — we’re investigating increased 500 responses from our US-West-2 inference cluster that may affect your production inference calls. Impact: intermittent request failures and occasional >30s latencies. Mitigation: manual capacity add + immediate fallback to our US-East cluster for Stratus if needed. ETA: 20–30 minutes. Point of contact: Tim (on-call) tim@redwood.ai, phone: +1-555-820-1999. We will update you at 15-minute intervals and follow up with a post-incident summary."

sara (support): sending to Janelle & Marco now; copying Tim for escalation.

tim (oncall): copied. If we failover, share change window and confirm they can accept transient request routing to us-east.

incident-bot: Alert update: manual capacity add failed due to provider quota. Initiating configured traffic failover for customer group: STRATUS-CLAIMS -> routing to us-east-1 fallback.

tim (oncall): failover initiated. Monitoring request rates and error budget.

status-bot: Updated status: "Mitigation in progress: affected enterprise traffic being routed to fallback region. Some requests may see increased latency while sessions re-establish. Next update in 10 minutes." Published to status page.

sara (support): Janelle confirmed she accepts routing to us-east; asked for ETA. I told her 10–15m for stabilization.

raj (eng): metrics show 5xx rate for Stratus down from 18% to 2% after failover. Embedding timeouts still a bit high for a small subset of sessions.

tim (oncall): Verified 5xxs <1.5% cluster-wide. Rolling back temporary canary model and keeping routing in us-east for Stratus until further notice.

lucy (cs): Notifying account team and scheduling follow-up call with Janelle and Marco to walk through root cause and credits.

tim (oncall): Incident resolved from an operational standpoint. Will keep monitoring for 30 minutes then close. Posting RCA draft later.

sara (support): Sending final tailored note to Stratus with summary, mitigation timeline, and direct contacts. Also including follow-up call invite.

incident-bot: Resolution: Autoscaler quota increased and manual adjustments completed; error rates returned to baseline. Incident transitioned to postmortem.

raj (eng): Opening PR for autoscaler runbook: add quota pre-checks and alternative instance families for scaling. Assigning to infra team.

lucy (cs): I'll include a tailored post-incident brief for Stratus with remediation steps and proposed credit for their impacted window.

tim (oncall): closing thread — thanks all. :white_check_mark:
